import ast
import copy
from pathlib import Path
path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\host_output.py')
module = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
helper = next(node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'is_copilot_view_payload')
namespace = {}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[helper], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
check = namespace['is_copilot_view_payload']
payload = dict.fromkeys(('sessionId', 'timestamp', 'cwd', 'toolName', 'toolArgs', 'toolResult'))
payload['toolName'] = 'view'
before = copy.deepcopy(payload)
assert check(payload) is True
assert payload == before
for key in payload:
    assert check({k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != key}) is False
assert check(dict(payload, extra=True)) is False
assert check(dict(payload, toolName='read')) is False
for value in (None, [], 'view', 1, set(payload)):
    assert check(value) is False
print('Helper checks passed')
